description: This Java class, ModifyThingStrategy, defines a strategy for handling the modification of 'Thing' entities in an Eclipse Ditto-based persistence service. It contains methods to process ModifyThing commands, handle different schema versions, merge modifications, and produce appropriate results and events.

classes.name: ModifyThingStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles modification commands for existing 'Thing' entities, supporting different schema versions and conditional logic based on whether schema version V1 or V2 is used.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Main entry point to process a ModifyThing command, dispatching to appropriate handlers based on schema version.

methods.name: handleModifyExistingWithV1Command
methods.description: Handles modifications for schema version 1, with logic to handle ACL updates and conditional processing.

methods.name: handleModifyExistingV1WithV1Command
methods.description: Processes a modify command targeting a V1 schema 'Thing', updating ACLs if necessary and creating a modified event.

methods.name: handleModifyExistingV2WithV1Command
methods.description: Handles API v2 modify commands targeting a V1 schema 'Thing', typically removing ACLs and ensuring policy ID presence.

methods.name: handleModifyExistingWithV2Command
methods.description: Dispatches between V1 and V2 schema versions for modify commands sent via API v2.

methods.name: handleModifyExistingV1WithV2Command
methods.description: Processes a modify command on a V2 'Thing' that contains a policy ID but is schema version V1.

methods.name: handleModifyExistingV2WithV2Command
methods.description: Handles modify commands for V2 schema 'Things', ensuring the 'Thing' has a policy ID.

methods.name: applyModifyCommand
methods.description: Applies the modifications from the command to the existing 'Thing', merging data and creating an event.

methods.name: mergeThingModifications
methods.description: Merges modifications from one 'Thing' into an existing 'Thing', updating relevant fields.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Handles unsupported or unhandled modification scenarios, returning an error result.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the EntityTag of the previous entity, if any.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the EntityTag of the new entity after modification, if any.
